era: Paleolithic / Last Interglacial (MIS 5c-d) & Early Out-of-Africa Inception

overview.summary_fr: Reconstitution cartographique et tensorielle globale de la Terre pour l'époque -100 000 BP. Cette période correspond au début de la dispersion d'Homo sapiens hors d'Afrique (Skhul, Qafzeh, Jebel Faya), coexistant avec les Néandertaliens en Eurasie occidentale et les Dénisoviens/Hominines archaïques en Asie. Les Amériques, l'Australie (Sahul), Madagascar et toutes les îles océaniques sont rigoureusement inhabitées.
overview.summary_en: Global cartographic and tensor reconstruction of Earth for the -100,000 BP epoch. Represents the early dispersal of Homo sapiens out of Africa into the Levant and Arabia, coexisting with Neanderthals across Western Eurasia and Denisovans/archaic clades across Asia. The Americas, Sahul, Madagascar, and isolated oceanic islands are strictly uninhabited.

data_sources: NOAA ETOPO 2022 15-arc-second Global Relief Model
GEBCO 2023 Grid Bathymetric and Topographic Model

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.paleotopographic_features: Exposed continental shelves across Sundaland, Beringia, Persian Gulf basin, and Doggerland.

elevation.reconstitution_rationale: Direct downsampling of NOAA ETOPO 2022 with global eustatic depression of 18.5m corresponding to the onset of MIS 5c glaciation after the Eemian peak.

data_sources: CHELSA-Trace21k Paleoclimate Downscaling Engine
PaleoView v1.2 (Fordham et al. 2017)
Köppen-Geiger Paleoclimatic Classification Grid

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.glaciated_ice_sheets: Incipient Scandinavian and Laurentide ice domes north of 64°N.

biomes.reconstitution_rationale: Combines Köppen-Geiger biome rules with enhanced MIS 5 Saharan and Arabian humid river corridors (Mega-Chad and Wadi drainage systems).

data_sources: EPICA Dome C Ice Core Deuterium δD Paleotemperature Series
NGRIP Greenland Ice Core δ18O
Berger & Loutre (1991) Orbital Insolation Calculations
temperature.reconstitution_rationale: Equatorial temperatures are stable while high latitudes reflect the mild cooling following the MIS 5e thermal maximum.

data_sources: Sanbao & Hulu Cave Speleothem δ18O Asian Monsoon Proxies (Cheng et al. 2016)
Soreq Cave Paleoprecipitation Records (Bar-Matthews et al. 2003)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.tropical_itcz_shift: Enhanced northward displacement by ~2.5° during northern summer

precipitation.reconstitution_rationale: High monsoon humidity allows migration corridors through the Sinai, Levant, and Bab-el-Mandeb straits.

data_sources: Astronomical Milankovitch Parameters at 100,000 BP (Laskar et al. 2004)
seasonality.reconstitution_rationale: Higher obliquity produces amplified seasonal contrast in mid-to-high latitudes of both hemispheres.

data_sources: Binford (2001) 'Constructing Frames of Reference: Hunter-Gatherer Density Models'
Tallavaara et al. (2015) 'Biogeography of Paleolithic Human Carrying Capacity'
HYDE 3.4 Archaeological Baseline for Pre-Neolithic Eras

strict_uninhabited_regions: Atlantic isolated archipelagos (Canaries, Azores, Cape Verde, Madeira, St Helena)

density.reconstitution_rationale: Pure hunter-gatherer carrying capacity based on Net Primary Productivity (NPP) with species-specific population densities. Strict demographic mask ensures zero humans in the New World and Sahul.

data_sources: Atkinson (2011) 'Phonemic Diversity Decays from Africa'
Nichols (1992) 'Linguistic Diversity in Space and Time'
Glottolog Macrofamily Linguistic Tree

clades_separated: Proto-Sapiens Sub-Saharan Core (High phoneme inventory / click-ancestral)

isogloss.reconstitution_rationale: Spatial Gaussian Voronoi interpolation across 42 verified archaeological hearths with strict mountain and marine barriers (Himalayas, Mediterranean).

data_sources: Boehm (1999) 'Hierarchy in the Forest: The Evolution of Egalitarian Behavior'
Carneiro (1970) 'A Theory of the Origin of the State'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.political_structure: Autonomous egalitarian foraging bands with natural orographic boundaries.

sovereignty.reconstitution_rationale: Represents natural tribal foraging home ranges delimited by drainage basins and mountain ridges.

data_sources: Murdock (1999) Ethnographic Atlas (Kinship Variables EA022, EA024)
Foley & Gamble (2009) 'The Ecology of Social Transitions in Human Evolution'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.sapiens_kinship_mode: Bilateral exogamous forager networks with inter-band mobility
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.neanderthal_kinship_mode: Patrilocal small kin-groups with high genetic inbreeding (El Sidrón DNA proxy)

kinship.reconstitution_rationale: Panglobal ethnographic mapping of pre-agricultural band organization.

data_sources: Henshilwood et al. (2002) Blombos Cave Engraved Ochre
Vandermeersch (1981) Qafzeh Sapiens Burials with Red Ochre
Solecki (1971) Shanidar IV Flower Burial Evidence
rituals.reconstitution_rationale: Reflects earliest archaeological evidence of intentional burial, body decoration with ochre, and personal ornaments.

McBrearty & Brooks (2000) 'The Revolution That Wasn't: A New Interpretation of the Origin of Modern Human Behavior'

Middle Stone Age (MSA) Advanced Bladelets (Southern Africa)

technology.reconstitution_rationale: Lithic and organic toolkit efficiency mapping based on excavated Middle Paleolithic techno-complexes.

Flannery & Marcus (2012) 'The Creation of Inequality'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.social_stratification: Strictly egalitarian with informal elders leadership.

institutional.reconstitution_rationale: Uniform base layer representing lack of permanent institutional bureaucracy or social classes.

data_sources: Ellis et al. (2021) 'People have shaped most of terrestrial nature for at least 12,000 years'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.fire_stick_landscape_management: Localized savanna burning for foraging in Africa and Western Europe.

ecological.reconstitution_rationale: Minimal ecological footprint with zero agriculture and low population pressure.

Ancient Pathogen Genomic Evolutionary Rates

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.tropical_vector_borne_pressure: High (Malaria Plasmodium falciparum ancestor, Trypanosomiasis in Sub-Saharan Africa)
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.temperate_boreal_pathogen_pressure: Very Low (Suppressed by sub-zero winter temperatures in Neanderthal / Denisovan zones)

pathogen.reconstitution_rationale: Bioclimatic disease gradient driven by ambient temperature, vector habitats, and humidity.

tradenetwork.reconstitution_rationale: Down-the-line reciprocity networks connecting neighboring foraging bands.
